$comment: Licence provenance for every DelayPilot asset that visual-asset-director did not draw. Hand-maintained; scripts/assets/verify-assets.mjs asserts that every path resolves and every field is present. Adding an asset without a record here fails the build, which is the point: 'it looks like it is free' is not a licence.

statement.originalWork: Every file under apps/web/public/brand/**, apps/web/public/icons/** and apps/web/public/og/**, plus the root apps/web/public/favicon.ico, is original work drawn by visual-asset-director for DelayPilot, derived by scripts/assets/build-assets.mjs and scripts/assets/build-globe.mjs from apps/web/public/brand/mark.svg. The root favicon.ico is the same encoded bytes as apps/web/public/icons/favicon.ico, written twice by one build so that /favicon.ico resolves for user agents that never parse <link rel="icon">; it is not separate artwork. The only third-party material anywhere in those trees is the Geist glyph outlines recorded below.
statement.noThirdPartyMarks: No airline, airport, regulator or data-provider logo, wordmark, tail livery, roundel, seal, crest or trade dress appears in any asset under those paths, including the root favicon.ico. No EU flag, no DOT/CAA/CTA seal, no IATA/ICAO emblem, no FlightAware/Cirium/OAG branding, redrawn, recoloured, traced or abstracted (AGENTS.md §1.4).
statement.noPhotography: DelayPilot ships no raster photography. apps/web/public/images/ is deliberately empty: there is no licensed photograph, and no AI-generated aircraft or airport imagery, which would fabricate liveries and registrations (AGENTS.md §1.1).
statement.noFabricatedData: No asset contains a flight number, gate, terminal, time, date, probability, statistic, review score, user count or itinerary detail, real or realistic. The only text in any asset is the product name and the DIRECTIVE.md §7 promise line (AGENTS.md §1.1, §2, DIRECTIVE.md §28).
statement.conceptBoards: design/concepts/2026-09-11-homepage/ holds reference-only concept boards. They are not shipped, not served and not ported to code; design/** is excluded from lint, formatting and the build. Their artwork is original inline SVG with no photography and no third-party mark, and the only licensed material in them is the embedded Geist subsets recorded below.

assets.description: Geist Regular, Latin subset. Self-hosted webfont delivered by brand-design-director; recorded here because visual-asset-director owns the licence manifest.
assets.source: geist@1.7.2 on the npm registry (dist/fonts/geist-sans/Geist-Regular.ttf), published by Vercel
assets.permittedCommercialUse: Yes. OFL 1.1 grants use, study, copy, merge, embed, modify, redistribution and sale of modified and unmodified copies, with no commercial restriction, provided the font is not sold by itself (clause 1) and every copy carries the copyright notice and licence (clause 2). DelayPilot bundles it with the site and sells subscriptions, not the font.
assets.modificationRights: Yes, including subsetting. Clause 3 forbids only reusing a Reserved Font Name, and this font declares none: the licence's copyright line is 'Copyright (c) 2023 Vercel, in collaboration with basement.studio' with no 'with Reserved Font Name' clause.
assets.attribution: Geist. Copyright 2024 The Geist Project Authors (https://github.com/vercel/geist-font). Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1.
assets.attributionRequired: The licence text must travel with the font, which it does at apps/web/public/fonts/LICENSE-Geist.txt. OFL requires no visible on-page credit.
assets.verificationMethod: Executed `npm view geist@1.7.2 license repository.url homepage dist.integrity` against the live npm registry, which returned 'SIL OPEN FONT LICENSE', git+https://github.com/vercel/geist-font.git and sha512-Gu5lDFa3pLRyoBlBPf0QIFHVdWAnpco7fS1bJm41jyLPFoguBgiubseUN2oLXMgqZ7uxAxDoXcHMhCY/fOTTgg==. Executed `npm pack geist@1.7.2` and read the full OFL 1.1 text out of the tarball; sha256 930853ee1daa68554d9e35c8a9175affb74f699fad9a5da6ee5ebe76379d9137 matches apps/web/public/fonts/LICENSE-Geist.txt byte for byte. Read the shipped woff2's own name table: name ID 4 'Geist Regular', ID 0 the Geist Project Authors copyright, ID 14 https://openfontlicense.org.
assets.verificationLimitation: https://openfontlicense.org and raw.githubusercontent.com are not reachable from this build environment (the egress proxy returns 403 and GitHub API access is not enabled for this session), so the canonical licence page was not fetched. The licence text was verified against the distributed artifact itself, which is the copy that governs this redistribution.

assets.description: Glyph outlines, advance widths and kerning for exactly two fixed strings — 'DelayPilot' and 'Stay ahead of flight disruptions.' — extracted from Geist by scripts/assets/wordmark-paths.py. Not shipped to browsers; consumed at build time by build-assets.mjs.
assets.source: Derived from geist@1.7.2 Geist-SemiBold.ttf and Geist-Regular.ttf. The sha256 of each source file is recorded inside the JSON.
assets.permittedCommercialUse: Yes. OFL 1.1 clause 5 states that the requirement for fonts to remain under the licence 'does not apply to any document created using the Font Software', which is the settled reading for text converted to outlines in a logo or an image. DelayPilot does not rely on that reading alone: the full licence text and the copyright notice ship with the product anyway, so OFL clause 2 is satisfied on the stricter reading as well. This is the fail-safe position and it costs nothing (AGENTS.md §1.5).
assets.modificationRights: Yes. Outlines are transformed (y-flip, scale, translate) and re-serialised; no glyph shape is altered. No Reserved Font Name is used or implied — 'DelayPilot' is DelayPilot's own product name, set in Geist, not a font name.
assets.attribution: Wordmark set in Geist SemiBold; promise line in Geist Regular. Copyright 2024 The Geist Project Authors. SIL Open Font License 1.1.
assets.verificationMethod: Regenerated in this session from the tarball fonts and re-verified with `python3 scripts/assets/wordmark-paths.py --font-dir <tarball> --check`, which compares the committed JSON byte for byte against a fresh extraction.

Embeds a Geist Regular subset (9,748 bytes) and a Geist SemiBold subset (10,056 bytes) as data:font/woff2 URIs so the board opens offline with no network request.
